sources.title: Atlas: A Framework for ML Lifecycle Provenance & Transparency
sources.snippet: Abstract We propose Atlas, a framework that enables fully attestable ML pipelines to address ML supply chain risks. Atlas leverages runtime pipeline monitoring and open specifications for data and software provenance to collect model artifact integrity and end-to-end lineage metadata.
